name: Pell's Lantern Wick
description: A charred wick from the last lamp Pell lit. One end remembers the flame. The other remembers the dark.
shiftEffect: Ki drains 15% slower while in the Astral Plane.

name: Dova's Stall Weight
description: A brass weight, heavy on one face and light on the other. Dova says it was always honest. She does not say to whom.
shiftEffect: Ki recovers 20% faster while in the Material Plane.

name: Hask's Cracked Clapper
description: The clapper of a bell that rang twice for every strike. Brother Hask keeps it in his sleeve. It hums when he's nervous.
shiftEffect: The Perfect Shift window is 0.08 seconds wider.

name: Tamsin's Thread Whistle
description: A whistle made from bone-white thread. Tamsin says you can't hear it here. She says it is very loud somewhere else.
shiftEffect: Each Astral Plane stay lasts 2 seconds longer.

name: Pell's Shuttered Lens
description: A lantern lens with a little door. Open, it shows what is there. Closed, it shows what was.
shiftEffect: Astral stay is 1 second longer, but Material Plane Ki recovers 10% slower.
